Metastasi ossee litiche da carcinoma pol: Lytic bone metastases from lung carcinoma: S1 almost completely replaced by tumor; lytic lesions in L5, T1 and T2
71-year-old man with lung carcinoma. Non-contrast CT from neck to pelvis (thin slices, reconstructed here at 2.5 mm), performed to plan stereotactic radiotherapy of vertebral metastases. Lumbosacral pain.
Leggi lo scheletro con la finestra per l: Read the skeleton with the bone window and the sagittal reconstructions.
Le metastasi ossee del carcinoma polmona:
Bone metastases from lung carcinoma are usually lytic: trabecular bone is replaced by soft-tissue-density tissue, then the cortex is breached and a paravertebral or presacral mass may appear. They are read with the bone window (about 400/1800), on the axial images and on sagittal and coronal reconstructions (use the MPR), counting levels from the sacrum or from C2.

The sacrum is a classic blind spot: it lies at the lower margin of abdominal CT scans, superimposed on bowel gas, and lysis of S1 is easily missed. The report should state the level, the part of the vertebra (body, pedicle, lamina), cortical breach, collapse, extension into the canal or foramina. For stability the SINS score (Spinal Instability Neoplastic Score) is used; for neurological risk look for compression of the thecal sac and roots (MRI if needed).
Nelle TC oncologiche guarda sempre il sa: On oncologic CT always look at the sacrum and the first thoracic vertebrae: they are at the edges of the field.
Dati della collezione Spine-Mets-CT-SEG:: Data from the Spine-Mets-CT-SEG collection: primary lung carcinoma; lytic lesions in T1, T2, L5 and S1, with S1 almost completely replaced by tumor.

È la lesione maggiore segnalata nei dati: It is the largest lesion reported in the collection data: the sacrum must always be examined, on axial and sagittal images, because on chest and abdominal CT it is often at the edge of the field and gets missed.

T1 e T2 sono al limite superiore del cam: T1 and T2 are at the upper limit of the field: look for them with the bone window.
